description: This PHP source file handles the user profile update functionality in an e-commerce application. It includes processing form submissions for updating user details such as name, email, and password, and incorporates SQL statements for updating records in the 'users' table. It also includes HTML markup for the profile update form and links external CSS and PHP components.

methods.name: none
methods.description: This script does not define custom classes or methods; it uses procedural code and external functions.
